scope: Tracks and cars revision: verified all 100 original hashes against the existing ledger, and freshly inspected 12 originals relevant to the authored geometry. This is not a fresh visual inspection of all 100 images.

records.inspection_method: Opened the original image bytes directly with view_image (default high display; tool may resize). Not inferred only from file names or an old ledger.
records.observation: The black wheel has a hub and disc recessed behind a narrow bright rim lip. Front circular black apertures have rounded raised edges; the picture does not establish active projector lights inside those apertures.
records.proposed_original_transfer: Retain hub/barrel separation, real spoke sidewalls and distinct inlet depth. Do not describe these unlit circular openings as verified lit projectors.

records.inspection_method: Opened the original image bytes directly with view_image (default high display; tool may resize). Not inferred only from file names or an old ledger.
records.observation: A narrow unpaved path runs between tall seed grasses toward layered forested ridges and a snowy mountain. There is no close paved road or guardrail in the foreground.
records.proposed_original_transfer: Useful for scenic framing and ground-cover scale, not exact guardrail or asphalt geometry evidence.

records.inspection_method: Opened the original image bytes directly with view_image (default high display; tool may resize). Not inferred only from file names or an old ledger.
records.observation: A dark mountain hairpin has a silver rail and regularly spaced warm marker faces. Only the rail section near approaching headlamps is strongly illuminated; distant rail stays dim.
records.proposed_original_transfer: Separate reflector faces from support hardware, retain subdued unlit metal, and keep road edge continuity readable.

records.inspection_method: Opened the original image bytes directly with view_image (default high display; tool may resize). Not inferred only from file names or an old ledger.
records.observation: A wet winding road shows a bright rolled metal beam with an open gap beneath it; a wire fence stands behind the roadside rail. Orange flexible markers follow the driveable boundary.
records.proposed_original_transfer: Give beam a manufactured cross-section and keep hardware outside the driving envelope. Exact C-post sections and terminals are not measurable in this view.

records.inspection_method: Opened the original image bytes directly with view_image (default high display; tool may resize). Not inferred only from file names or an old ledger.
records.observation: A stadium circuit sits inside a larger precinct of parking, footpaths and local approach roads. Multiple nested spaces have distinct surface treatments.
records.proposed_original_transfer: The independent club circuit can have a clear connector and driveable route; this is not evidence for copying the stadium.

records.inspection_method: Opened the original image bytes directly with view_image (default high display; tool may resize). Not inferred only from file names or an old ledger.
records.observation: The infield course separates dark asphalt, striped edge, colored apron and fenced protected interior. Broad curves connect to an uninterrupted straight.
records.proposed_original_transfer: Use readable course-edge transitions, protected infield and variation between bends and straight. Width, lap count and circuit geometry remain authored choices.

records.inspection_method: Opened the original image bytes directly with view_image (default high display; tool may resize). Not inferred only from file names or an old ledger.
records.observation: Four front-facing cars remain visually separate through varied nose and lamp designs, wheel angles and spacing in a festival corner.
records.proposed_original_transfer: Keep body families and steerable wheels distinct; this image cannot establish collision handling or racing AI behavior.

records.inspection_method: Opened the original image bytes directly with view_image (default high display; tool may resize). Not inferred only from file names or an old ledger.
records.observation: Successive hairpins vary in radius and join straighter connectors. Silver rails follow curves beside white edge paint; underbeam ground, grass and retaining slopes remain distinct.
records.proposed_original_transfer: Retain continuous outer road edge, repeated support rhythm and room for a clear trajectory between bends.

records.inspection_method: Opened the original image bytes directly with view_image (default high display; tool may resize). Not inferred only from file names or an old ledger.
records.observation: Cars align at a visible transverse line before a long unobstructed strip. Staging islands, perimeter runoff and spectator sides are clearly separated.
records.proposed_original_transfer: Use an obvious start reference and unobstructed acceleration section. Do not infer six-lane drag mechanics or a measured width for the original club course.

records.inspection_method: Opened the original image bytes directly with view_image (default high display; tool may resize). Not inferred only from file names or an old ledger.
records.observation: The blue hatch has a tall glass cabin, broad front shoulder, deep lower grille, nested white guides within dark lamp housings and visibly different body proportions from nearby coupes.
records.proposed_original_transfer: Maintain a recognizable hatch silhouette and distinct glazing/intake layers.

records.inspection_method: Opened the original image bytes directly with view_image (default high display; tool may resize). Not inferred only from file names or an old ledger.
records.observation: The classic car has a bright rim lip, inset six-spoke center and fastener ring; the disc lies behind spoke gaps. Behind it, the rail has two bright longitudinal ridges, a darker middle channel, bolt rows, separate pale posts and small round reflector faces on stems.
records.proposed_original_transfer: Keep rim lip, barrel, spoke center and brake depth separate. Give the rail a rolled cross-section and independently visible posts/reflectors. Exact metric construction remains original.

records.inspection_method: Opened the original image bytes directly with view_image (default high display; tool may resize). Not inferred only from file names or an old ledger.
records.observation: The rear three-quarter supercar shows thin forked spokes with visible sidewall thickness and a recessed brake disc/red caliper behind the spokes. Deep rear honeycomb openings expose additional internal shapes; exhausts have open inner bores.
records.proposed_original_transfer: True branching spokes and recessed brake components are grounded here. Open rotor cooling-channel topology is an original construction detail responding to depth, not a measured fact recovered from this whole-car image.

limits: Still images support visible form/material/composition only. Metric construction dimensions, braking thermal performance, grip, dynamics and driving enjoyment cannot be measured from these images.
Archive source metadata attributes the images to Microsoft / Xbox Game Studios / Playground Games; it was preserved as supplied, not independently reverified through an external source download.
Images remain reference inputs and are not intended to be redistributed or installed as game textures.
